title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the bound lab notebook. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Bound Lab Notebook
options.lineage: computation notebooks: eye-ease green pages, printed form headers, signed and witnessed entries
options.thesis: Every number on screen is a witnessed entry: dated, sourced, and never erased.
materials: printed form labels in green ink
options.viewport: Cover-green top bar with the book label; the result entry at specimen scale (static 1 of 17, fused 9 of 17) in blue ink; the task roster beneath; a witness line under every figure naming its command and file.
options.risk: Grid paper behind tables would turn it into a costume; the grid stays a spacing module, not a texture.

raised.raise: Hierarchy by scale contrast: the result figures set at specimen size, everything else small and quiet.
The task list is a finite roster: every row carries the same fixed furniture in the same positions.
One spacing module, the notebook's 5 mm square, governs every gap and row height.
Verdicts are marks in fixed cells, filled for pass and hollow for fail, never coloured pills.
Recorded and live results are an honest, visible state, never blended.
Counts sit right-aligned in tabular figures, tight against their column edge.

options.label: Clinical Trial Report
options.lineage: medical-journal trial reports: CONSORT flow diagram and the two-arm results table
options.thesis: Report the experiment the way trials are reported: allocation, arms, placebo, outcome.
options.viewport: A CONSORT flow from 166 runtime-only targets down to 17 treatment tasks, splitting into static and fused arms with their pass counts; the placebo arm beside it.
options.risk: Familiar: it lands where most research dashboards land, a journal table on white; reads as a figure more than a tool.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.lineage: mixtape j-cards, side a and side b in ballpoint
options.thesis: The two arms as side a and side b of one folded card.
options.viewport: One task unfolded flat: static as side a, fused as side b, counts right-aligned.
options.risk: Whimsy undercuts a jury reading for rigour.
options.case: Fuses neatly onto two arms, but examiners do not identify with it and it adds nothing the two columns lack.
options.kept: Counts right-aligned in tabular figures against the column edge.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1971 pocket airline timetable on a light table
options.thesis: One type size; rank carried by weight, case and rule.
options.viewport: Tasks as raked timetable slides with state marks in fixed cells.
options.risk: Raked panes fight code excerpts that must stay legible.
options.case: Single-size type and raked panes cost legibility on dense code; examiners have no tie to it.
options.kept: Verdicts as marks in fixed cells, filled or hollow.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The grid as visible armature; the layout is the proof.
options.viewport: Result figures drawn cell by cell over a visible grid.
options.risk: A visible grid on a working screen reads as decoration.
options.case: Strong system, weak tie to research examiners; the visible grid competes with tables.
options.kept: One spacing module governs every gap.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: One giant form, everything else tiny.
options.viewport: The headline result as a single giant glyph with axis readouts.
options.risk: Type theatre with nothing for the method.
options.case: No audience tie and no product mapping beyond scale.

options.label: Emigre Bitmap Specimen
options.viewport: Pixel display headline over dense columns.
options.risk: Pixel display type reads retro, not rigorous.
options.case: Loses both axes for a research jury.
options.kept: Honest, visible state toggles instead of blended states.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: A finite ranked roster with fixed personal furniture.
options.viewport: Tasks as ranked cells with name plates.
options.risk: Pastel mascot grammar trivialises the result.
options.case: Loses both axes; only its roster discipline transfers.
options.kept: Every roster row carries identical fixed furniture.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean light experiment dashboard: KPI tiles, a results table, a diff-style task view.
canonCard.viewport: Four stat tiles over a sortable task table; the task view as two diff panes.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every ML-eval dashboard by design.
